programme.title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
programme.desc: The Horror Hound festival holds its first ever event in Louisiana, attracting hundreds of geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans from far and wide. Fanboy Chase forces his girlfriend Laine to come along for the ride. As the event begins, Laine starts to experience unexplained premonitions and disturbing visions. As the blood-soaked entertainment builds to a frenzy, Laine believes that something unearthly has been summoned and that she is at the center of it.

programme.title: Waris Jari Hantu
programme.desc: The story of Tina and Ari who will inherit the science of tigers from Tok Wan. But only one will be elected. Who will be the heir?

programme.title: The House of Snails
programme.desc: Writer Antonio Prieto decides to spend the summer in the mountains outside Malaga, where he hopes to find peace and quiet as well as inspiration for his next novel. Once there, he meets Berta, a woman he feels instantly attracted to. However, Antonio soon finds out that the locals are hiding numerous secrets, as well as a dark and terrifying legend. His experiences there will lead him to discover that, sometimes, reality is much stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Malam Tahlil Suhaila Balik
programme.desc: In bearing the pain of Suhaila's death, her husband faces an unexpectedly problem when she returns home at one of his 'tahlil' nights.

programme.title: The Slit Mouthed Woman 2
programme.desc: 1978, Gifu prefecture, Japan. Three sisters grow up on a chicken farm in a small town. The oldest sister, Yukie, is engaged to be married, the middle sister, Sachiko works at a beauty salon and the youngest, Mayu, is on the track team in high school. Their happy carefree lives are changed forever when Yukie's ex-boyfriend Suzuki commits an atrocious crime with Mayu as the tragic victim. Half-crazed and bent on revenge against their family, Suzuki mistakes Mayu for Yukie and pours acid all over her face. Overwhelmed by physical and psychological trauma, Mayu sinks deeper into depression and isolation, unresponsive to her sisters' encouragement. Meanwhile, chilling news of a serial murderer, who preys on the alumni of Mayu's high school, send shockwaves through their small town.

programme.title: Puaka Balai Gombak
programme.desc: A group of arrogant paranormal seekers continuously discredit the existence of spiritual entities in popular haunted sites in Malaysia. However it appears that they will eventually find what they truly seek at the abandoned police station in Gombak.... And as the saying goes.... be careful what you wish for....

programme.title: Janet: Sumpah Terlarang
programme.desc: Sarawak, 1970s. Janet, a nurse, heads home after ending a late-night shift. But she never shows up at home. On the way, she is kidnapped by mysterious assailants and butrally murdered in a horrific ritual, all to appease angry spirits that have been preventing the completion of the Satok Bridge. Fast forward to present-day Kuala Lumpur, where Julia, a Sarawakian girl, is a beaming bride-to-be and happily planning her wedding to Farid. Julia is well-received by her soon-to-be in-laws, but she has no idea about the terrible secrets from their past. One day, Janet picks up a hairpin to keep her hair tidy. What follows soon after changes her life forever.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.

programme.title: Potret Moyang
programme.desc: Maria & Johan tidak suka pulang ke kampung emaknya semasa cuti sekolah. Kekurangan fasiliti di kampung dan juga kerana takutkan potret moyang mereka yang tergantung di rumah kampung.

programme.title: Penanggal
programme.desc: The story of Murni, who accidentally inherits the dark art of Penanggal from Mak Ajeng and is forced to flee to Kampung Jawa for her safety.

programme.title: Project Gemini
programme.desc: Through an international project known as Gemini, a planet terraforming unit is formed. But the unit loses connection with Earth and floats out of the solar system. Years after the unit is considered lost, a group of astrophysicists receive a mysterious signal from outer space. A small group is sent off into the great and unkown abyss to locate the source of the signal and save the Earth from destruction.

programme.title: Bila Malam Pocong Menangis
programme.desc: 3 friends who are bike enthusiasts spend the night camping on a river bank in the forest. While having a good time, they are startled by an unusual sound. Upon paying attention, they realize it is the sound of someone crying. Joey, being the bravest of the trio, goes into the forest in the direction of the voice. Afraid of being left behind and not wanting to split up, Hazama and Celli have no choice but to follow suit. They finally trace the howling to its source. Joey shines his torchlight and the three friends are horrified to see a very ugly pocong crying in the middle of the forest.

programme.title: I Wish I Wish aka Deseo Deseo
programme.desc: Five cousins reunite at the house of their recent deceased grandmother. As they rummage through her belongings, they discover a curious board game titled 'I Wish, I Wish (Deseo, Deseo).' Out of boredom, they decide to play the game together. The rules are simple: each player may ask 3 wishes that will be fulfilled after completing a challenge presented by the game. If they carry it out they will have what they desire; otherwise there are far reaching consequences. The players soon learn the game truly grants their wishes -- at a heavy cost. For those who have chosen not to fulfill the challenge, the game releases a vicious creature to enforces punishment on their loved ones. The group soon discover that they must keep playing, and risking others is the only way to save themselves.
